blocks.text: Khas liquid crystal devices se jism mein tumours aur infections ka pata lagaya ja sakta hai, kyunke tumour jaise problems ka temperature aas paas ke tissue se aksar alag hota hai. Cholesteric liquid crystals breast (chhati) par lagane se tumour baqi hisson se garam hone ki wajah se nazar aa jata hai. Is tareeqe se breast cancer ki early (shuru ki) stage mein kamyabi se diagnosis hoti hai.
